summary: All task requirements are met. The shared robot layer (darwin_robot.py) gets its own node via getSelf() and finds others/barriers by scanning root children matching the 'name' field, never getFromDef('DARWIN'); locomotion is behind _LocomotionBackend which tries the Robotis managers and falls back to a documented stub with a warning. DarwinRaceEnv exposes a 5-dim normalized Box observation and Discrete(3) action space, implements the safe-learning reward (progress, goal bonus+terminated, safety-radius intrusion penalties, fall/collision penalties) and fills info with fall/collision/margin_violations/progress/success; the stable_baselines3 check_env test passes. PPO, DQN and A2C each live in their own controller file (ppo_agent/dqn_agent/a2c_agent) using MlpPolicy with SB3 default hyperparameters (only seed/verbose set) documented in each header. run_experiments.py enumerates 108 configs (>=20) varying all four required dimensions (space_size, start position, goal, per-algorithm hyperparameters) and writes results/experiments.csv via pandas; plot_results.py produces cumulative_reward.png, success_rate.png and summary.csv. The custom agent (custom_agent.py, robot 'agente propio') is a manual tabular Q-learning implementation with no stable-baselines3 import, clearly marked as the Taller-2 placeholder with TODO and a CustomAgentExtensionPoint. pista_atletismo_50m.wbt wires exactly the four controller fields (dqn_agent/custom_agent/ppo_agent/a2c_agent) to the four robots by name with geometry, 12 WorkBarriers, DEF START_FINISH plane at y=9, DEF DARWIN and supervisor/selfCollision flags all intact and matching the plan. requirements.md is untracked and unmodified. RaceWinnerDetector correctly reports the first robot to cross y=GOAL_Y. Full pytest suite: 51 passed, 0 skipped (SB3 and matplotlib are installed in .venv). Experiments, plots and winner detection were sanity-run end-to-end and produce the expected artifacts. Note (non-blocking): the .wbt was committed whole in the final commit rather than pre-existing, so there is no git baseline to diff 'controller-only'; geometry was verified intact by inspection against the plan.
